notes.title: Din's Curse Steam Cards
notes.content:
Din's Curse now has Steam Cards, so start collecting & trading now!

The set includes:
[list]
    [*]8 cards
    [*]6 badges (as usual)
    [*]5 profile backgrounds
    [*]8 emoticons
[/list]

tags.feature: - Din's Curse now has Steam Cards, so start collecting & trading now!
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
- A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
